// Reconstruct a lookAt view matrix from eye position looking at the origin.
mat4 buildLookAt(vec3 eye, vec3 center, vec3 up)
{
  vec3 f = normalize(center - eye);
  vec3 s = normalize(cross(f, up));
  vec3 u = cross(s, f);

  mat4 m = mat4(1.0);
  m[0][0] =  s.x; m[1][0] =  s.y; m[2][0] =  s.z; m[3][0] = -dot(s, eye);
  m[0][1] =  u.x; m[1][1] =  u.y; m[2][1] =  u.z; m[3][1] = -dot(u, eye);
  m[0][2] = -f.x; m[1][2] = -f.y; m[2][2] = -f.z; m[3][2] =  dot(f, eye);
  m[0][3] = 0.0;  m[1][3] = 0.0;  m[2][3] = 0.0;  m[3][3] = 1.0;
  return m;
}

### P2 "01_SphereSplat_Generator" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: SPHERESPLAT TEST GENERATOR — creates N particles arranged in a ring, each with position, color, and sprite_size. Connect output directly to SphereSplat to verify the renderer works with generated geometry. All attributes are per-instance: SphereSplat expects 6 vertices per particle (computed via gl_VertexIndex%6) with position/color/sprite_size varying per-instance.; categories: Test, Feedback; resources: geo:geometry, numParticles:long, ringRadius:float, spriteSize:float

```glsl
vec3 hsv2rgb(float h, float s, float v)
{
    vec4 K = vec4(1.0, 2.0 / 3.0, 1.0 / 3.0, 3.0);
    vec3 p = abs(fract(vec3(h) + K.xyz) * 6.0 - K.www);
    return v * mix(K.xxx, clamp(p - K.xxx, 0.0, 1.0), s);
}

void main()
{
    uint idx = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
    uint count = uint(numParticles);
    if(idx >= count)
        return;

    // Ring in XZ plane (so SphereSplat's default cameraPos above looks down on it)
    float t = float(idx) / float(count);
    float angle = t * 6.28318530718 + TIME * 0.3;

    vec3 pos = vec3(
        cos(angle) * ringRadius,
        sin(TIME + angle * 3.0) * 0.3, // gentle vertical wave
        sin(angle) * ringRadius
    );

    vec3 col = hsv2rgb(t, 0.9, 1.0);

    ISF_WRITE(geo, position)[idx]    = vec4(pos, 1.0);
    ISF_WRITE(geo, color)[idx]       = vec4(col, 1.0);
    ISF_WRITE(geo, sprite_size)[idx] = vec4(spriteSize, spriteSize, 0.0, 0.0);
}
```

### P3 "02_SphereSplat_Feedback" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: FEEDBACK MODIFIER for SphereSplat test — reads particle positions from the generator, samples a feedback texture at each particle's world-XZ projection, and uses the sampled color as each particle's output color. Pipeline: Generator → THIS → SphereSplat → Window, with a feedback edge from SphereSplat output back to this node's 'feedbackTex' input. Without feedback, particles will be nearly black …; categories: Test, Feedback; resources: geoOut:geometry, geoIn:geometry, feedbackTex:texture, feedbackStrength:float, baseColor:float, projectionScale:float

```glsl
void main()
{
    uint idx = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
    uint count = uint(ISF_READ(geoIn, in_position).length());
    if(idx >= count)
        return;

    vec4 pos    = ISF_READ(geoIn, in_position)[idx];
    vec4 inCol  = ISF_READ(geoIn, in_color)[idx];
    vec4 inSize = ISF_READ(geoIn, in_sprite_size)[idx];

    // Rough top-down projection: particle world-XZ -> feedback texture UV [0,1]
    vec2 uv = pos.xz * projectionScale + 0.5;
    uv = clamp(uv, 0.0, 1.0);

    vec4 fb = IMG_NORM_PIXEL(feedbackTex, uv);

    // Output color = baseline (from generator) + feedback sample amplified
    vec3 outCol = inCol.rgb * baseColor + fb.rgb * feedbackStrength;

    ISF_WRITE(geoOut, out_position)[idx]    = pos;
    ISF_WRITE(geoOut, out_color)[idx]       = vec4(outCol, 1.0);
    ISF_WRITE(geoOut, out_sprite_size)[idx] = inSize;
}
```
